profile.headline: Product designer moving into product management

careerPaths.name: Product management
careerPaths.why: Co-owned the Tidewater Travel booking roadmap, ran weekly customer interviews and defined checkout success metrics.

careerPaths.name: Product design with product ownership
careerPaths.why: Owned end-to-end booking design at Tidewater Travel and co-owned its roadmap; design roles count only with product ownership.

preferences.notes: Moving into product management. Senior design roles count only when they include clear product ownership such as roadmap or outcome responsibility. Pure visual or brand design roles are not wanted.

cv:
Senior Product Designer, Tidewater Travel, London, 2019–present
- Owned end-to-end design for the booking flow across web and mobile apps.
- Ran weekly customer interviews and synthesised findings into opportunity backlogs.
- Partnered with the product manager to prioritise the quarterly roadmap using impact and effort scoring.
- Defined success metrics for checkout experiments and lifted booking conversion by 9%.

Product Designer, Kestrel Health, London, 2015–2019
- Designed patient appointment flows and a shared design system.
- Planned and moderated usability tests with clinicians and patients.

Education: BA Interaction Design, 2015

facts.subject: Roadmap ownership
facts.detail: Co-owned the booking roadmap with the product manager for two years.

facts.subject: Visual brand design
facts.detail: Applied existing brand guidelines to product screens.
